from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(".env")
from relocation_jobs.core.db import _utc_now, db_transaction

overrides = {
    Path("docs/README.md"): "doc-index",
    Path("docs/archive/README.md"): "archive",
    Path("docs/proposals/README.md"): "proposals",
    Path("docs/reference/commands/README.md"): "commands",
}

def title_of(text: str, path: Path) -> str:
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith("# "):
            title = line.strip()[2:].strip()
            if len(title) > 200:
                raise SystemExit(f"title too long: {path}")
            return title
    raise SystemExit(f"missing h1: {path}")

pages = []
seen = set()
for path in sorted(Path("docs").rglob("*.md")):
    slug = overrides.get(path, path.stem)
    if slug in seen:
        raise SystemExit(f"duplicate slug {slug}")
    seen.add(slug)
    if len(slug) > 80:
        raise SystemExit(f"slug too long: {slug}")
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    body = text.strip() + "\n"
    if len(body) > 200_000:
        raise SystemExit(f"body too long: {path} {len(body)}")
    pages.append((slug, title_of(text, path), body, str(path)))

inserted = []
skipped = []
now = _utc_now()
with db_transaction() as conn:
    for slug, title, body, src in pages:
        existing = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM team_docs WHERE folder = %s AND slug = %s",
            ("tech", slug),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing:
            skipped.append(slug)
            continue
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO team_docs (
                folder, slug, title, body, created_at, updated_at,
                created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id
            ) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
            """,
            ("tech", slug, title, body, now, now, None, None),
        )
        inserted.append(slug)

print(f"pages={len(pages)} inserted={len(inserted)} skipped={len(skipped)}")
print("inserted:", ", ".join(inserted))
if skipped:
    print("skipped:", ", ".join(skipped))
PY

    Path("docs/README.md"): "doc-index",
    Path("docs/archive/README.md"): "archive",
    Path("docs/proposals/README.md"): "proposals",
    Path("docs/reference/commands/README.md"): "commands",
}

def title_of(text: str, path: Path) -> str:
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith("# "):
            title = line.strip()[2:].strip()
            if len(title) > 200:
                raise SystemExit(f"title too long: {path}")
            return title
    raise SystemExit(f"missing h1: {path}")

pages = []
seen = set()
for path in sorted(Path("docs").rglob("*.md")):
    slug = overrides.get(path, path.stem)
    if slug in seen:
        raise SystemExit(f"duplicate slug {slug}")
    seen.add(slug)
    if len(slug) > 80:
        raise SystemExit(f"slug too long: {slug}")
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    body = text.strip() + "\n"
    if len(body) > 200_000:
        raise SystemExit(f"body too long: {path} {len(body)}")
    pages.append((slug, title_of(text, path), body))

inserted = []
skipped = []
now = _utc_now()
with db_transaction() as conn:
    for slug, title, body in pages:
        existing = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM team_docs WHERE folder = %s AND slug = %s",
            ("tech", slug),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing:
            skipped.append(slug)

        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO team_docs (
                folder, slug, title, body, created_at, updated_at,
